title: Jobs and careers
focus: 面试 · 简历 · 辞职 · 跳槽 · 升职 · 待遇 · 合同 · 部门
body:
# Jobs and careers

The words for working life beyond the daily grind: interviews, CVs, contracts, promotions and moving on. Friends and parents ask about all of these.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 面试 | miànshì | job interview / to interview | face-to-face test → interview |
| 简历 | jiǎnlì | résumé / CV | a brief history of you |
| 辞职 | cízhí | to resign / quit (a job) | take leave of your post |
| 跳槽 | tiàocáo | to switch jobs (to another company) | jump to another feeding trough |
| 升职 | shēngzhí | to get promoted | rise in post → promoted |
| 待遇 | dàiyù | pay and benefits (the whole package) | the treatment you meet with |
| 合同 | hétong | contract | joined in the same terms |
| 部门 | bùmén | department (in a company) | section-branch → department |

## Which word?

**辞职 vs 跳槽**: 辞职 is just quitting; 跳槽 is leaving for another company.

**待遇 vs 工资**: 待遇 is the whole package (pay, benefits, holidays); 工资 is the salary only.

## Sentences

- 明天面试，我有点焦虑。 míngtiān miànshì, wǒ yǒudiǎn jiāolǜ: I have an interview tomorrow and I'm a bit anxious.
- 面试之前，把简历再检查一遍。 miànshì zhīqián, bǎ jiǎnlì zài jiǎnchá yí biàn: Before the interview, check your CV once more.
- 尽管待遇不错，她还是辞职了。 jǐnguǎn dàiyù búcuò, tā háishi cízhí le: Even though the pay and benefits were good, she still quit.
- 跳槽不见得待遇更好。 tiàocáo bújiànde dàiyù gèng hǎo: Switching companies doesn't necessarily get you a better package.
- 他升职以后压力更大了。 tā shēngzhí yǐhòu yālì gèng dà le: Since his promotion, he's been under even more pressure.
- 辞职之前，先看看合同怎么写。 cízhí zhīqián, xiān kànkan hétong zěnme xiě: Before you resign, see what your contract says.
- 我们部门的领导很靠谱。 wǒmen bùmén de lǐngdǎo hěn kàopǔ: The boss in our department is really dependable.
- 没机会升职，我只好跳槽了。 méi jīhuì shēngzhí, wǒ zhǐhǎo tiàocáo le: There was no chance of promotion, so I had to move to another company.

cards.Example: 我明天上午有个面试。 wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ yǒu ge miànshì: I have a job interview tomorrow morning
cards.Notes: 面 miàn face (见面, 面对) + 试 shì try, test, 讠 speech (考试, 试试) = a face-to-face test, so a job interview. Mirror: 笔试 (笔 pen) = written test.

cards.Example: 你把简历发给我看看。 nǐ bǎ jiǎnlì fā gěi wǒ kànkan: Send me your résumé and I'll take a look
cards.Notes: 简 jiǎn simple, brief (简单) + 历 lì past experience (经历, 历史) = a brief history of you, so a résumé. 投简历 = send in a résumé.

cards.Example: 她上个月辞职了。 tā shàng ge yuè cízhí le: She quit last month
cards.Notes: 辞 cí take leave, decline (告辞, 辞别) + 职 zhí post, job (职业, 职员) = take leave of your post, so resign. Shares 职 with 升职. 辞职 = you quit; 被辞退 / 被开除 = you got fired.

cards.Example: 他又跳槽了,工资涨了不少。 tā yòu tiàocáo le, gōngzī zhǎng le bù shǎo: He switched jobs again and got a big pay rise
cards.Notes: 跳 tiào jump, 足 foot (跳舞, 跳高) + 槽 cáo trough (水槽 sink, 马槽 manger) = jump to another feeding trough, like a horse changing mangers, so switch employers. Informal but universal.

cards.Example: 恭喜你升职了! gōngxǐ nǐ shēngzhí le: Congratulations on your promotion!
cards.Notes: 升 shēng rise (上升, 升旗) + 职 zhí post, job (职业, 职员) = rise in post, so get promoted. Shares 职 with 辞职. 升职加薪 = promotion and a raise, a common pair.

cards.Example: 那家公司待遇不错。 nà jiā gōngsī dàiyù búcuò: That company pays well and has good benefits
cards.Notes: 待 dài treat (对待, 招待) + 遇 yù meet with, encounter (遇到) = the treatment you meet with, so pay and benefits. 待遇 = the whole package; 工资 = salary only.

cards.Example: 签合同之前一定要看清楚。 qiān hétong zhīqián yídìng yào kàn qīngchu: Read it carefully before you sign the contract
cards.Notes: 合 hé join, agree (合作, 合适) + 同 tóng same (同意) = joined in the same terms, so a contract. 签合同 = sign a contract; 续签 = renew.

cards.Example: 你在哪个部门? nǐ zài nǎge bùmén: Which department are you in?
cards.Notes: 部 bù part, section (部分, 全部) + 门 mén door; also branch, category (专门) = a section-branch, so a department. 部 also names ministries: 外交部.

cards.English: I have an interview tomorrow and I'm a bit anxious.
cards.Notes: 面试 (L16) + 焦虑 (L15). 面试 is both the noun and the verb.

cards.English: Before the interview, check your CV once more.
cards.Hanzi: 面试之前，把简历再检查一遍。
cards.Pinyin: miànshì zhīqián, bǎ jiǎnlì zài jiǎnchá yí biàn.
cards.Notes: 面试 (L16) + 简历 (L16) + 检查 (L10). 投简历 = send in a CV.

cards.English: Even though the pay and benefits were good, she still quit.
cards.Hanzi: 尽管待遇不错，她还是辞职了。
cards.Pinyin: jǐnguǎn dàiyù búcuò, tā háishi cízhí le.
cards.Notes: 待遇 (L16) + 辞职 (L16) + 尽管 (L14). 辞职 = you quit; 被辞退 = you were let go.

cards.English: Switching companies doesn't necessarily get you a better package.
cards.Notes: 跳槽 (L16) + 待遇 (L16) + 不见得 (L14). 跳槽 = jump to another trough: informal but universal.

cards.English: Since his promotion, he's been under even more pressure.
cards.Hanzi: 他升职以后压力更大了。
cards.Pinyin: tā shēngzhí yǐhòu yālì gèng dà le.
cards.Notes: 升职 (L16) + 压力 (L4). 升职加薪 = promotion and a raise.

cards.English: Before you resign, see what your contract says.
cards.Hanzi: 辞职之前，先看看合同怎么写。
cards.Pinyin: cízhí zhīqián, xiān kànkan hétong zěnme xiě.
cards.Notes: 辞职 (L16) + 合同 (L16). 同 is neutral tone in 合同: hétong.

cards.English: The boss in our department is really dependable.
cards.Hanzi: 我们部门的领导很靠谱。
cards.Pinyin: wǒmen bùmén de lǐngdǎo hěn kàopǔ.
cards.Notes: 部门 (L16) + 领导 (L6) + 靠谱 (L12). 哪个部门？ = which department?

cards.English: There was no chance of promotion, so I had to move to another company.
cards.Hanzi: 没机会升职，我只好跳槽了。
cards.Pinyin: méi jīhuì shēngzhí, wǒ zhǐhǎo tiàocáo le.
cards.Notes: 升职 (L16) + 跳槽 (L16) + 机会 (L4). 只好 = had no choice but to.
